name: Light Mint
lede: Light Mint is a very pale yellowish green recorded only in the 2010 xkcd color survey, close enough to two other surveyed names to call them near-duplicates.

sections.title: A light build of mint
sections.body:
The nearest named colors on file are [[seafoam]], [[celery]], [[very-light-green]] and [[very-light-green]], at 3.4, 3.7, 4.2 and 4.5 ΔE [1]. The ISCC-NBS system classes it as very light yellowish green, about 4 units from the nearest ISCC-NBS block center [1]. Its Munsell notation is 0.9G 9.4/9.0 and its LCH values are lightness 94, chroma 44, hue 144 degrees, among the lightest greens in our library [1]. In sRGB its components run 182 red, 255 green and 187 blue, so the green channel runs at its full strength while red and blue sit close together [1].

Two other xkcd names sit within about 2 units of this swatch: Light Mint Green and Light Seafoam Green [2]. That near-duplication is normal for crowd-surveyed modifier names: different respondents described the same pale green with slightly different words. See [[seafoam]] for the related sea-foam family.

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive has a color within CIEDE2000 4 of Light Mint covering even 1% of its canvas, as photographed [3]. That describes this archive, not painting as a whole [3].
